title: Stasis
description: A woman in a green and cream Victorian-style dress stands at a wooden desk, writing in a notebook with a quill while holding a glowing blue orb containing a red anatomical heart. The room has purple walls covered in framed alchemical and anatomical diagrams.
prompt: A beautiful dark-haired woman in an emerald green Victorian dress with cream sleeves and red embroidery stands at a large wooden desk in a study with purple walls. She is writing with a quill in one hand and holding a glowing blue orb containing a red anatomical heart in the other. The desk is covered with an open book of glowing purple arcane circles, scrolls, a red lantern, green wax seals, and scissors. The walls are filled with many framed anatomical and occult diagrams in teal and gold frames. Warm magical lighting, intricate details, rich colors.
